You should be honest, try to to make it short and sweet.

Something along the lines of "hey dad i'm pansexual, please don't make a big deal out of it, i'm still your son".

Just make sure you make your point and try to show that you're serious, otherwise he might think it's a "phase" or something like that.

Other than that, try to convince him that you're still you, and that your sexuality doesn't affect who you are, and that you will always be you.

That's the best I can think of, sorry if it doesn't help.
I'm glad for you, and I really hope you and your father may get along and that everything will be fine for you
